function measureFit(c, observedWidth?): void

Defined in: website/components/carousel/custom-carousel/sizing.ts:58

Decides whether the items fit side-by-side (no carousel chrome) or need the scroll track. Side-by-side requires: ≤2 items, no landscape item (too wide to pair), viewport ≥ SIDE_BY_SIDE_BREAKPOINT, and projected total width ≤ host width. Projection: each item lays out at maxH = MAX_HEIGHT_VH of viewport height, so rendered width ≈ (w/h)·maxH plus ITEM_GAP_PX flex gap. Items missing intrinsic sizes use GENERIC_DIMENSIONS defaults (conservative portrait) so a partial CMS row can't silently flip to scroll mode.
